title: Titans GM Mike Borgonzi: Our goal is to sign Peter Skoronski to an extension

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Titans GM Mike Borgonzi: Our goal is to sign Peter Skoronski to an extension
sources.description: Titans General Manager Mike Borgonzi wasn't on the job when left guard Peter Skoronski was drafted in the first round in 2023, but he'd like to keep the three-year vet on the roster for a while.
